examples.target: 年紀漸長，他花更多時間陪家人。

examples.source: The film reminds us that age marches on.
examples.target: 這部電影提醒我們歲月不饒人。

examples.source: Choose work that aligns with your values.
examples.target: 選擇符合你價值觀的工作。

examples.source: The school's approach aligns with parents' values.
examples.target: 學校的方法符合家長的價值觀。

examples.source: Her decision did not align with her values.
examples.target: 她的決定不符合自己的價值觀。

all hands on deck.meaning: 全員出動 / 需要大家一起幫忙

examples.source: It was all hands on deck before the school fair.
examples.target: 校園市集前需要全員出動。

examples.source: When the system failed, it was all hands on deck.
examples.target: 系統故障時，需要大家一起幫忙。

examples.source: The event was huge, so it was all hands on deck.
examples.target: 活動很大型，所以需要全員出動。

all signs point to.meaning: 所有跡象都指向 / 顯示

examples.source: All signs point to a rise in demand.
examples.target: 所有跡象都顯示需求上升。

examples.source: All signs point to better results this year.
examples.target: 所有跡象都指向今年成績更好。

examples.source: All signs point to the need for change.
examples.target: 所有跡象都顯示有改變的需要。

always on.meaning: 長期在線的 / 隨時工作的

examples.source: Many students feel trapped in an always-on culture.
examples.target: 很多學生覺得被長期在線的文化困住。

examples.source: An always-on phone can make rest difficult.
examples.target: 長期在線的手機會令人難以休息。

examples.source: The support team runs an always-on service.
examples.target: 支援團隊提供隨時工作的服務。

examples.source: She knows this neighbourhood as familiar as the back of her hand.
examples.target: 她對這個社區非常熟悉。

examples.source: The guide knows the museum as familiar as the back of his hand.
examples.target: 導遊對博物館非常熟悉。

examples.source: After years of practice, he knew the route as familiar as the back of his hand.
examples.target: 多年練習後，他對路線非常熟悉。

examples.source: As is the case with many skills, practice matters.
examples.target: 正如很多技能的情況一樣，練習很重要。

examples.source: As is the case with teenagers, sleep affects learning.
examples.target: 正如青少年的情況一樣，睡眠影響學習。

examples.source: As is the case with new apps, users need time to adapt.
examples.target: 正如新 app 的情況一樣，用戶需要時間適應。

examples.source: The campsite made us feel at one with nature.
examples.target: 營地令我們感到與大自然融為一體。

examples.source: She feels at one with nature when hiking.
examples.target: 她行山時感到與大自然融為一體。

examples.source: The wooden house was designed to feel at one with nature.
examples.target: 木屋設計成讓人感覺與大自然融為一體。

at one's peril.meaning: 自行承擔風險 / 後果自負

examples.source: Ignore safety rules at your peril.
examples.target: 忽視安全規則，後果自負。

examples.source: Students skip revision at their peril.
examples.target: 學生不溫習就要自行承擔風險。

examples.source: Use weak passwords at your peril.
examples.target: 使用弱密碼，後果自負。

at peace with.meaning: 坦然接受 / 內心平靜

examples.source: She is at peace with her decision.
examples.target: 她坦然接受自己的決定。

examples.source: He felt at peace with the past.
examples.target: 他對過去感到內心平靜。

examples.source: After apologising, she was at peace with herself.
examples.target: 道歉後，她內心平靜。

examples.source: Safety was at the forefront of her mind.
examples.target: 安全放在她心中首位。

examples.source: Student needs are at the forefront of the teacher's mind.
examples.target: 學生需要放在老師心中首位。

examples.source: Cost was at the forefront of everyone's mind.
examples.target: 成本放在每個人心中首位。

at the top of one's game.meaning: 處於最佳狀態 / 表現巔峰

examples.source: The pianist was at the top of her game.
examples.target: 鋼琴家處於最佳狀態。

examples.source: He played like someone at the top of his game.
examples.target: 他的演出像處於表現巔峰的人。

examples.source: The team was at the top of its game in the final.
examples.target: 團隊在決賽中處於最佳狀態。

at the top of one's game.meaning: 處於最佳狀態 / 表現頂尖

examples.source: The chef is still at the top of his game.
examples.target: 廚師仍然處於最佳狀態。

examples.source: She writes like an author at the top of her game.
examples.target: 她寫作時像一位表現頂尖的作家。

examples.source: Even at the top of his game, he kept practising.
examples.target: 即使表現頂尖，他仍然不斷練習。

examples.source: Her results attest to her hard work.
examples.target: 她的成績證明她很努力。

examples.source: The photos attest to the changes in the city.
examples.target: 相片證實城市的變化。

examples.source: Many parents can attest to the value of reading.
examples.target: 很多家長可以證明閱讀的價值。

automate away.meaning: 以自動化取代 / 令...因自動化而消失

examples.source: Some simple tasks may be automated away.
examples.target: 一些簡單任務可能被自動化取代。

examples.source: Technology can automate away boring paperwork.
examples.target: 科技可以以自動化取代沉悶文書工作。

examples.source: Not every human job can be automated away.
examples.target: 不是每份人類工作都會因自動化而消失。

examples.source: She is averse to wasting money.
examples.target: 她不願意浪費金錢。

examples.source: Some parents are averse to too much screen time.
examples.target: 有些家長反對太多螢幕時間。

examples.source: He is not averse to trying new ideas.
examples.target: 他並不反對嘗試新想法。

examples.source: The company is averse to risks after losing money.
examples.target: 公司虧損後不願冒險。

examples.source: He is averse to risks, so he plans carefully.
examples.target: 他不願冒險，所以計劃很小心。

examples.source: Investors may become averse to risks during uncertain times.
examples.target: 不明朗時期，投資者可能變得不願冒險。

examples.source: The market was awash with cheap products.
examples.target: 市場充滿廉價產品。

examples.source: The street was awash with colour during the festival.
examples.target: 節日期間街道佈滿色彩。

examples.source: Social media is awash with comments about the film.
examples.target: 社交媒體充滿關於電影的評論。
